programmes.title: Women's Online Madrasah
programmes.descShort: Beginner-friendly Islamic studies for women 18+. Pre-recorded lessons on Google Classroom so you can learn at your own pace.
programmes.descLong: Beginner-friendly Islamic studies for women 18+. Pre-recorded lessons on Google Classroom so you can learn at your own pace. Covers Aqaaid, Fiqh, Tajweed, Seerah, Akhlaaq, Hadith & Du'as.
programmes.terms:
Class Format & Content:
You will receive 2 pre-recorded lessons per week via Google Classroom.
All homework must be submitted as part of your progress.
Exams are compulsory and must be completed within the given time frame.

Attendance & Accountability:
Even if you do not watch the videos during a particular month, but you remain enrolled, you are still liable to pay the monthly fee.
Your progress is monitored, and homework & exam completion will be tracked.

Fees:
Registration Dates
Registration opens on 1 November 2026 and closes on 1 January 2027.
Classes begin in January 2027.
Registration Fee
A once-off, non-refundable registration fee of R50 is required.
The registration fee must be paid immediately after registering to secure your place in the class.
Students who do not pay the registration fee may lose their placement.
Monthly Fees
The monthly fee is R150 per month.
Payment Deadline
All fees must be paid by the 1st of each month at the latest.
If, for any reason, you are unable to pay on time, you must inform the Mu’allimah before the due date.
Fees are non-refundable once access to the classroom is granted.

Commitment & Conduct:
This is a safe, non-judgmental learning space. All students must be respectful and sincere.
Any inappropriate behaviour may result in removal from the class.

Privacy:
All personal information will be kept confidential.
Please do not share videos, content, or class materials with anyone who is not registered.
